thread.title: Stock News Today: Uptrend Wobbles As Apple Leads Another Tech Sell-Off

author: EdJenner
title: Stock News Today: Uptrend Wobbles As Apple Leads Another Tech Sell-Off
text:
Go to Article
The stock market started off the week where it left off Friday, with sellers dictating the action. In stock news today, the technology sector faced another round of sharp selling, with shares of Apple ( AAPL ) down 4%. It was a big decliner in the Nasdaq 100, along with other technology stocks like Broadcom ( AVGO ), Nvidia ( NVDA ) and Micron Technology ( MU ).
X
Results from Nvidia are due Thursday after the close. Its chart is in rough shape, but a few names in compelling setups ahead of earnings reports this week were featured in the latest Earnings Preview column.
After falling 1.6% Friday, the Nasdaq composite was down an additional 2.3% in afternoon trading Monday. After three straight closes above its 200-day moving average, the S&P 500 fell below the line again, down 1.5%. The Dow Jones industrial average dropped below its 50-day line, falling 1.8%. Volume on the NYSE and Nasdaq was tracking slightly lower than Friday’s levels. Stock News Today
In stock market news, shares of Apple lagged badly after Lumentum Holdings ( LITE ) cut its earnings outlook. Lumentum, a key Apple supplier, said a large customer asked it to “materially reduce shipments.”
Meanwhile, tobacco stocks were down across the board on reports that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration is considering a ban on menthol cigarettes. British American Tobacco ( BTI ) was the biggest decliner in the group, down 7%. Altria Group ( MO ) gave back 2%. Philip Morris ( PM ) lost 1%. Software Mergers
Meanwhile, acquisition news was plentiful in the software sector. German software firm SAP ( SAP ) agreed to acquire data analytics firm Qualtrics for $8 billion. Qualtrics’ IPO was scheduled for this week. Shares of SAP plunged 6% on the news.
Shares of Apptio ( APTI ) surged 51% to 37.61 after it agreed to be acquired by Vista Equity Partners for nearly $2 billion, or 38 a share.
Meanwhile, hedge fund Elliott Management and private equity firm Veritas Capital announced a deal to acquire Athenahealth ( ATHN ) for $5.5 billion, or 135 a share. Shares of Athenahealh gained 10% to 132.
In other stock news today, shares of Amedisys ( AMED ) were down 3%. It’s testing support at the 50-day line as it works on a base with a 127.48 entry. The health care provider was featured in Monday’s Stock Spotlight .
Finally, after five straight weekly declines, U.S. crude oil futures were up 0.9% Monday to $60.74 a barrel after Saudi Arabia said Sunday it would cut output next month.
